max_peaks.title: Maximum peaks
max_peaks.description: Number of isotope peaks retained per molecule; the most abundant peaks are kept and sorted by m/z.

min_relative_abundance.title: Minimum relative abundance
min_relative_abundance.description: Peaks below this fraction of the base peak are discarded before the peak cap is applied.

charge.title: Charge state
charge.description: Positive charge z used for m/z conversion, assuming [M+zH]z+.

molecule_dim.title: Molecule dimension
molecule_dim.description: Name of the molecule axis in the input form.

field_dim.title: Field dimension
field_dim.description: Name of the field axis holding encoded SMILES in the input form.

output.title: Output name
output.description: Context name of the output form.
